conditions.requires: Serene Seasons installed, native crop policy enabled, and the optional registry member present; native dimension, biome, greenhouse, underground and fertility configuration retain authority.

conditions.delivery: Integration in the full local pack is tracked in Mods/JEMCompat/seasons-delivery.json; native runtime and player acceptance remain separate.

change.summary: Extend the existing native Serene Seasons tag policy to reviewed missing food crops and productive plant stages; retain one native fertility owner and matching tooltip windows.

before.source: Existing JEMCompat tag files at 9c10424f3d0f3dc10db54098ef173f8556932aa1; same crop policy as e3fb8c01381520edd20dafb3c2b9f73acc5a607b. Native vanilla/Kaleidoscope coverage is additional and unchanged.

after.seasons: Read each matched source-set filename; an ID may belong to several seasons. year_round_crops is consumed by native seasonal tags. unbreakable_infertile_crops protects marked perennials only in native destructive mode.

modifiers.notes: Actual growth-stage blocks and real seed/plant items only. All members optional and replace:false. This includes explicit year-round policy, not 53 new crop species or a claim that all crops are season-restricted.

modifiers.before: Farm & Charm lettuce was autumn-only and tomato summer-only; corresponding Kaleidoscope Cookery crops already used spring/autumn and summer/autumn.
modifiers.after: Farm & Charm lettuce adds spring; tomato head/body and seed add autumn. All other pre-existing native/JEM windows remain.

modifiers.before: Untagged custom growth routes were not proof of native seasonal integration.
modifiers.after: Tagged random ticks and native player-bonemeal policy govern supported routes. Shared Vinery trellis stays year-round; Unearthed Journey queued tree placement remains year-round; Nether mutation seed items retain their original terrestrial windows. Mature Spawn sunflower uses its separate exact-ID adapter record.
modifiers.notes: No broad scheduled-callback, machine-fertilizer or direct-growth interception is claimed. Harvesting ripe crops, recipes, food values, drops, worldgen, climate tags and dimension whitelist remain unchanged.

rationale.purpose: Provide missing crop compatibility before the wider compatibility implementation prompt without duplicating seasonal state or replacing native growth.
rationale.decision_source: User requested implementation of the supplied crop-compatibility patch on 2026-10-23; seasonal windows and adapter mechanics follow that supplied technical direction.
rationale.user_requested: Implement all supplied Serene Seasons crop compatibility and coordinate with the parallel handbook/Hint/Jade chat.
rationale.implementation_choices: Use exact registered stages and optional native tags; include productive food trees, protect perennials, align two existing crop families, and preserve explicit cave/Nether/End/aquatic and shared-trellis year-round exceptions. New season assignments are pack design choices.
rationale.source_references: Mods/JEMCompat/SEASONS.md links the release source commits and exact release archives used for registration/growth inspection; the hashes above identify original Atlas artifacts, not newly deployed outputs.

introduced.summary: Add 34 reviewed growable food/fruit families (53 additional unique block IDs and 44 additional tooltip item IDs), align Farm & Charm tomato/lettuce, preserve existing native windows and document explicit year-round/native-route exceptions.

history.summary: Add 34 reviewed growable food/fruit families (53 additional unique block IDs and 44 additional tooltip item IDs), align Farm & Charm tomato/lettuce, preserve existing native windows and document explicit year-round/native-route exceptions.

Merge supplied policy with current source and parallel handbook build dependencies; inspect exact installed Spawn and Serene Seasons bytecode and retain native fertility authority. Delivery receipt records production and installation evidence.

relations: native crop tags -> Serene Seasons fertility -> random tick admission
productive leaves -> crop production and native leaf decay timing
crop availability -> downstream recipes and food economy without recipe or price edits
notes: Current pack mode 0 retains the native 1/6 infertile random-tick chance rather than stopping or destroying crops. Current Overworld-only policy, Y48 underground exemption and greenhouse handling remain native.
Desert turnip includes summer so native tropical-biome fertility does not make it permanently infertile. Climate-biome classifications are a separate pending compatibility task.
Psycho berry uses spring/winter. Cave, Nether/End and aquatic crops retain year-round ecology. Year-round membership does not override the native explicit infertile-biome rule.
Do not mark shared Kaleidoscope chili, vanilla pumpkin or torchflower seeds year-round. Do not season-tag the mature Spawn sunflower block; its unique seed-only adapter preserves rotation.
Vinery stem stores grape variants in one GRAPE property; this change deliberately retains its year-round behavior and does not claim per-variety equivalence to seasonal bushes.

Fruit-leaf random-tick gating can also slow leaf decay out of season. Nature Spirit coconut propagation is bonemeal-only. Unearthed Journey tree callbacks remain native and ungated under their year-round policy.

All 71 affected namespaced IDs, including the mature adapter target, were queried against canonical Atlas behavior; changed entries resolve in their actual block/item registries, with no prior native season membership or relevant season-rule conflicts.

Exact installed Spawn 4.0.7 and Serene Seasons 9.1.0.3 SHA256 match the referenced Atlas artifacts; javap confirms tryAdvanceRotation/setBlock and performBonemeal descriptors and the public native fertility callback. Local fertility config remains enabled with behavior 0 and underground level 48.
unresolved: Gameplay acceptance, greenhouse/biome conditions, dispenser/direct bonemeal and absent-mod JVM loading remain unexercised; no tests or client gameplay launches are authorized.
Other mod fertilizers, queued callbacks and direct automation are not universally intercepted; documented native exceptions remain deliberate.
